definitions.explanation: Something that is expected or goes without saying. A matter of course.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧。

examples.english: It's only natural to be grateful to your parents.

examples.japanese: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live an ordinary life.

examples.japanese: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：02368_shiawase⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気|き}づいた→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: I realized that ordinary daily life is the happiest.

notes:
{当|あ}たり{前|まえ} indicates something is natural or expected.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}の/な + noun
- Noun: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}だ (is natural/obvious)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (it's only natural)
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (naturally, as a matter of course)
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (take for granted)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧: natural, obvious (formal)
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}: natural, obvious (casual)
- ⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧: of course (affirmation)
